scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build src/index.ts --target bun --format esm --outfile dist/index.js && bun scripts/make-executable.mjs
scripts.build:binary: bun run clean:binary && bun build --compile --minify --sourcemap src/index.ts --outfile dist/app
scripts.build:binary:bytecode: bun run clean:binary && bun build --compile --bytecode --minify --sourcemap src/index.ts --outfile dist/app
scripts.build:binary:linux: bun run build:binary:linux:x64 && bun run build:binary:linux:arm64
scripts.build:binary:macos: bun run build:binary:macos:x64 && bun run build:binary:macos:arm64
scripts.build:binary:all: bun run clean:binary && bun run build:binary:linux && bun run build:binary:macos && bun run build:binary:windows
scripts.verify: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run smoke:source && bun run build && bun run smoke && bun run build:binary && bun run smoke:binary
